units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional teaching staff of educational organisations implementing basic general education programmes (hereinafter, educational organisations) for personal merits:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in improving and developing the education system of the City of Moscow;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in improving and developing the education system of the City…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in teaching activities ensuring sustained positive trends in learning indicators, high academic achievements by students, and the preparation of winners and prize-winners of regional, all-Russian and international Olympiads;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in teaching activities ensuring sustained positive trends in…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in developing and introducing into the educational process innovative teaching technologies, forms and methods, educational programmes and teaching and methodological manuals;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in developing and introducing into the educational process…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in organising and improving upbringing activities in the educational organisation and promoting students’ moral, intellectual and cultural development.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in organising and improving upbringing activities in the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional teaching staff means persons with the highest qualification category who have received state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR, departmental awards or awards of the City of Moscow, or hold honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or are winners of professional skills competitions, and who have worked in the education system of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: Up to 100 honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ are awarded annually.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “Up to 100 honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is not awarded a second time to the same person.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ is the highest form of recognition for merits in healthcare in the City of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional practising physicians of medical organisations within the state healthcare system of the City of Moscow, who possess professional expertise and organisational skills, actively participate in the public life of the capital’s healthcare sector and in medical research, and are highly rated by colleagues and patients.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: Physicians are awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ for personal merits:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “Physicians are awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in providing timely and highly qualified primary healthcare, applying modern advances in medical science and technology in practice;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in providing timely and highly qualified primary healthcare,…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in introducing and applying new healthcare methods and improving existing ones, enabling reductions in morbidity and mortality and the provision of high-quality, timely medical care;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in introducing and applying new healthcare methods and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: - in successfully combining highly professional clinical practice with effective organisational and scientific work in medicine.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “- in successfully combining highly professional clinical…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional practising physicians means persons with the highest qualification category who have worked in medical organisations within the state healthcare system of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Department of Healthcare of the City of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ · “Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 1. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is the highest form of recognition for merits in the industrial sector of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional employees of entities operating in industry and other persons who have made a substantial contribution to the industrial development of the City of Moscow, for personal merits:
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.1. Increasing the efficiency of the City of Moscow’s industry, the quality of its products and their consumer properties.
units.label: Point 2.1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.2. Successfully fulfilling production assignments, developing and introducing new types of products into production in the City of Moscow, and increasing the share of domestically produced products.
units.label: Point 2.2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.3. Carrying out scientific, rationalisation and innovative activities that increase labour productivity, environmental performance and energy efficiency of production, and promote the stable development of the City of Moscow’s industry.
units.label: Point 2.3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.4. Creating new production facilities, industrial sites and industrial infrastructure in the territory of the City of Moscow using modern high-technology equipment.
units.label: Point 2.4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.5. Training qualified personnel for the industry of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 2.5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.6. Enhancing the social importance of skilled trades, preserving continuity between generations and developing multigenerational occupational traditions within families.
units.label: Point 2.6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 2.7. Achieving other significant results in implementing the industrial policy of the City of Moscow and in professional activities.
units.label: Point 2.7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 3. For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional employees of entities operating in industry means workers, engineering and technical personnel, researchers and heads of entities operating in the industrial sector of the City of Moscow who have received state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR, departmental awards or awards of the City of Moscow, or hold honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or are winners of professional skills competitions, and who work in industry in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 4. Persons working in other fields in the City of Moscow may be awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ for outstanding merits and achievements contributing to the development of industry in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 5. Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 6. Up to 100 honorary badges ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ are awarded annually.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
units.text: 7. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is not awarded a second time to the same person.
units.label: Point 7
